answer: A farm of 101 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in crystal, queued in ridge, and cipher publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 51 identities per epoch. A farm of 1499 identities would post 4552 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
